description: This file defines a utility class 'FormatFilename' that provides methods to shorten long file path strings for display purposes, especially in limited space UI components.

classes.name: FormatFilename
classes.description: A utility class to shorten long file path names to more manageable representations for display.

methods.name: getShortName(File)
methods.description: Returns a shortened version of the absolute path of a file if it exceeds 45 characters.

methods.name: getShortName(String)
methods.description: Returns a shortened version of a file path string by truncating and formatting parts of the path.
